description: Motorcycle model to category mapping for data import - resolves conflicts by using most common category

category_guidelines.Scooter: Automatic transmission, step-through design, under-seat storage. Includes all engine sizes (110cc-350cc+). Prioritize 'Scooter' over 'Big Scooters' for consistency.
category_guidelines.Adventure: Dual-purpose bikes designed for both on-road and off-road use, typically with upright seating position and high ground clearance.
category_guidelines.Sport: Performance-oriented motorcycles with aggressive styling and riding position, designed for speed and agility.
category_guidelines.Naked Bikes: Standard motorcycles without fairings, upright riding position, exposed engine.
category_guidelines.Touring: Long-distance motorcycles with comfortable seating, wind protection, and storage capacity.
category_guidelines.Dual-sport: Lightweight motorcycles designed primarily for off-road use but street legal.
category_guidelines.Cruiser / Custom Bikes: Low-slung motorcycles with forward foot controls and relaxed riding position.
category_guidelines.Cafe Racer: Classic styled motorcycles with sporty riding position and vintage aesthetics.
category_guidelines.Electric: Electric powered motorcycles and scooters of any type.

conflict_resolutions.Big Scooters vs Scooter: Use 'Scooter' - engine size doesn't determine category
conflict_resolutions.125-150cc vs Actual Type: Use actual motorcycle type (Naked Bikes, Sport, etc.) not engine displacement
conflict_resolutions.Various Models: Assign most common category for that brand or use brand's typical focus
